Posit Assistant asks for confirmation on every file it edits. Turning that off
wholesale gives an assistant that will also push to a shared branch and send a
data frame to a model provider. The setting that sits between the two is
`approvalMode`, and the file it belongs in is `.posit/assistant/settings.json`
in the project root, committed so that everyone working in the repository gets
the same posture.

This project scopes that file before writing it. The specification lists
twenty-two behaviors with a verdict on each, maps Posit's four approval modes
onto the Claude Code modes some of the group already use, and records what the
assistant sends to a provider without being asked. The last of those is the
finding to read first if the project holds patient data.

Nothing here has been run. The specification is a scoping document with six
open questions, and every source is marked as transcribed rather than checked.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The checklist of behaviors, the
  recommended settings file, the approval modes, the sandbox, the limits of
  what a settings file enforces, and the open questions.
- [References](references.qmd). The Posit documentation, the general
  cross-vendor guidance on agent permissions, and a marker on each recording
  whether the claim drawn from it has been checked against the source.
